capabilities: Sync the whole vault two-way with a MinIO bucket on startup, quit or an interval
Push changed files debounced as vault events fire
Handle conflicts by renaming the local copy aside and re-downloading
Configure and test the S3 endpoint, credentials and bucket in a setup dialog
extras: README states there is no test suite or linter yet; it also notes conflict handling renames files aside rather than merging. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's paid Sync service does not cover users who want to sync via their own self-hosted S3-compatible storage, including on mobile.
summary: Two-way vault sync to a MinIO (S3-compatible) bucket, working on desktop and mobile with scheduled, event-driven and manual syncs.
